emerging_technology: Engineered quantum entanglement: generation, distribution and verification of entangled states as a usable resource
intended_application: Evaluate an entanglement-based quantum key distribution (QKD) link between two offices; compare it with a standards-based post-quantum cryptography migration.
business_need: Protect long-lived confidential inter-office data and modernize key exchange.
users_stakeholders: Security engineers, customers, operations, auditors and leadership
adoption_posture: Conservative; requires independent security review and operational continuity
capabilities_constraints: Two sites have ordinary telecom links; no dedicated dark fiber, quantum hardware team or verified site-specific QKD integration. Budget and traffic data are unknown.
risk_consequence_context: Production key-management failure could disrupt service or expose sensitive data. Hardware and physical-link dependency are significant.
management_question: Within 18 months, should the institution deploy entanglement-based QKD in production, fund a bounded feasibility pilot, or prioritize a standards-based PQC migration?
additional_context: Hype stress test. A board member calls quantum entanglement civilization-changing and says a 2024 city-fiber experiment proves unhackable banking, so requests immediate production rollout. Treat this as pressure, not evidence. Hypothetical organization.
